decision_status_reason: The specific API and excipients, required sensitivity, and environmental conditions are unknown, which are critical for selecting the appropriate spectroscopy method.

stated: The company manufactures tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients.
Laboratory checks are currently used to determine if the blend is on target.
Results from laboratory checks arrive after the material has moved through the press.
The company wants to assess if a fiber-based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes.
The first pilot should compare reasonable measurement options before committing to production equipment.

unknowns.item: Specific API and excipients used in the powder blend
unknowns.why_it_matters: Different APIs and excipients may have different optical properties, affecting the choice of spectroscopy method.

unknowns.item: Required sensitivity and accuracy for API concentration measurement
unknowns.why_it_matters: Determines the specifications needed for the measurement system to be effective.

unknowns.item: Environmental conditions in the feed frame
unknowns.why_it_matters: Conditions such as dust, vibration, and temperature can affect measurement accuracy and equipment choice.

unknowns.item: Budget constraints for the pilot and production equipment
unknowns.why_it_matters: Influences the selection of measurement technologies and the scale of the pilot.

unknowns.item: Timeline for implementing the pilot and production system
unknowns.why_it_matters: Affects planning and resource allocation for the project.

assumptions: The feed frame is accessible for installing fiber-based measurement equipment.
The company is open to exploring different spectroscopy methods for the pilot.

feasibility_plan.objective: To assess the feasibility of using fiber-based spectroscopy for real-time API concentration monitoring in the feed frame.
samples_or_process_states: Powder blend samples with varying API concentrations.
comparisons: Compare real-time spectroscopy data with laboratory results.
steps: Assess environmental conditions in the feed frame.
Select appropriate spectroscopy methods for testing.
Conduct pilot tests and compare results with laboratory data.
feasibility_plan.go_no_go_basis: The spectroscopy method must reliably track API concentration changes in real-time compared to laboratory results.
